objections.objection: Why would we not build this ourselves? The mechanism seems straightforward.
objections.evidence_required: Demonstrate that the computational modeling, VVUQ, and adversarial attack work would take 6-12 months to reproduce internally. Show the cemetery entries that constrain the design space — mistakes we already made so they don't have to.
objections.resolution_path: Emphasize the Discovery Evidence Fabric as the asset — not just the invention. The system that discovered, attacked, and packaged this technology is the moat. Build-vs-buy analysis shows internal build time exceeds license time-to-market.

objections.objection: Why is this not obvious given Single-segment programmable valve (Medtronic Strata) — react? The combination of known elements may not be patentable.
objections.evidence_required: Patent defensibility analysis showing novelty score, closest prior art, and design-around risk. See Patent Defensibility Engine output.
objections.resolution_path: Patent search by buyer counsel. Our framework identifies the closest prior art and the specific mechanism difference. The cemetery entries show what was tried and failed — supporting non-obviousness.

objections.objection: What blocks regulatory approval? Is this Class II or Class III? What predicates exist?
objections.evidence_required: Preliminary regulatory assessment with predicate identification, likely testing requirements, and pathway hypothesis.
objections.resolution_path: Regulatory counsel confirms classification and predicate. Our package provides preliminary hypothesis (not legal opinion). 510(k) pathway likely for most shunt components; PMA for active implants.

objections.objection: What exactly are we buying? Is this a patent, know-how, or a development partnership?
objections.evidence_required: Clear deal structure with IP scope, know-how transfer, and development responsibilities.
objections.resolution_path: Recommended transaction: CO_DEVELOPMENT with computational + clinical split. Options include sponsored validation, exclusive license, co-development, or acquisition. See Commercial Deal Engine.

objections.evidence_required: Decisive experiment that resolves this specific failure/uncertainty.
objections.resolution_path: Commission the validation experiment ($3-5K bench + $50K+ for 3D multi-segment mesh). If PASS, objection resolved. If FAIL, walk away or co-develop repair.
